**Title**: Bridging Domain Gaps between Pretrained Multimodal Models and Recommendations  
**Abstract**:  
The paper addresses the challenge of domain gaps in recommendation systems using pretrained multimodal models. Despite the potential of these models, their performance is limited when applied directly, primarily due to feature distribution and task objective misalignment. The proposed solution, **Parameter-efficient Tuning for Multimodal Recommendation (PTMRec)**, employs a knowledge-guided dual-stage training strategy to bridge these gaps effectively.
